consumer: game::npc_menu, reached when the avatar moves into a tile occupied by an NPC, which builds a uilist (Talk/Swap positions/Push away/...) and asks via amenu.query() which interaction the player chooses.
scope: not applicable (interactive menu choice through the active input loop, not an item/map reach)
decisive_source: src/game.cpp::game::npc_menu — its body constructs a uilist of NPC interaction options and calls amenu.query() to obtain the player's choice through the real input loop, so the move-into-friendly-NPC outcome is an interactive prompt, not a fixed performed action.
divergence: Moving into a friendly NPC where the player would pick 'Swap positions' vs 'Push away': a backend that silently auto-resolves (e.g. always swaps, or no-ops) produces a different world state than the menu choice the engine would actually present, exposing the wrong answer.
